description: Defines the ILocalDataStore interface for local data storage operations in Orleans.

classes.name: ILocalDataStore
classes.description: Interface for local data storage operations, including reading, writing, deleting, and clearing data.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Property that gets the entity tag for versioning.

methods.name: WriteRow
methods.description: Writes a row of data identified by keys with an associated eTag.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a single row of data based on provided keys.

methods.name: ReadMultiRow
methods.description: Reads multiple rows of data based on provided keys.

methods.name: DeleteRow
methods.description: Deletes a row of data identified by keys if the eTag matches.
